cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Mum's coming for lunch. Is this spoon clean enough for her?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spoon's fine. You haven't cleaned the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. She checks cutlery. Could you check the forks while I finish this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've told her to bring rubber gloves and help you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a guest towel. Can you help me choose one without a faded stripe?

mechanism: A authorizes scrutiny of tiny hosting details to prevent attention settling on the larger kitchen-cleaning duty left undone.
confusable: D14 avoids any subject; D38 specifically uses minor details to distract from A neglected practical responsibility.
comparison: Cutlery and guest-towel choices keep an unclean kitchen unaddressed; the moving alternative uses labels instead of packing.
seedUse: Use D38-a spoon, forks and incoming cleaning help, with S01 approval controlling which detail B is allowed to address.
